title: EuropeTracker DraftBrief
description: The research agent's output, drafts/YYYY-MM-DD.json (SPEC.md §4.4). Generated from lib/schema by `npm run schema:gen`; do not edit by hand. Word budgets in descriptions are enforced by the validator.

date.description: Taipei date of the run; equals the file name

window.description: Exactly the window strings from the prompt

quiet_day.description: true when there are fewer than 3 material developments

weekly.description: true when date is a Monday; then weekly_outlook is required

bottom_line_source_ids.description: At least 2 source ids spanning at least 2 source categories

current_rung.description: Must equal the computed rung after adding today's incidents

probability.description: Integer 0–100 that lies inside the band of `term` (STYLE.md §7)

next_rung_odds.description: 30-day probability of any incident above the current rung; null only at rung 6

probability.description: Integer 0–100 that lies inside the band of `term` (STYLE.md §7)

serious_odds.description: 30-day probability of at least one serious incident in this pathway

impact.description: Consequence if it happens: 1 local disruption, 2 national under a day, 3 major disruption or casualties, 4 multiple deaths or alliance crisis, 5 war-level

trend.description: Against state: up if the probability rose 5 points or more, down if it fell 5 or more, else flat

rationale.description: ≤ 40 words: the base rate plus the reason for any change

source_ids.description: Source ids; at least 1 when the probability moved 15 points or more

previous_score.description: The state's score for tier-1 countries; null for tier 2

anyOf.description: ≤ 40 words; required when the score changed or is above the floor

source_ids.description: At least 1 when the score changed

indicator_ids.description: Active strategic indicators naming this country

cohesion_flag.description: Only Hungary or Slovakia may be flagged

countries.description: The 7 tier-1 countries in order (PL, LT, LV, EE, FI, RO, MD), then any tier-2 countries touched today

importance.description: At most one pivotal per brief

incident_ids.description: Incidents (new or existing) this development is about

strike_ids.description: Strikes (new or existing) this development is about

verification.description: Required when strike_ids is non-empty: the highest verification among them

attribution.description: Required when incident_ids is non-empty: the highest attribution among them

source_ids.description: At least 1; pivotal and major need at least 2 from at least 2 categories

text.description: material: ≤ 60 words; no_change: exactly "No material change."

development_ids.description: Development ids this note draws on

id.description: INC-YYYY-NNNN continuing context.next_ids.incident[YYYY], where YYYY is the year of date

date_precision.description: "month" only for seed records, with date = the 1st

location_country.description: BY, RU or UA only for military_pressure and nuclear

affected.description: European countries affected, at least 1; includes location_country if European

type.description: A key of INCIDENT_TYPES[pathway], or "other". airspace: drone_incursion, missile_incursion, aircraft_violation, debris_impact, shootdown, airport_closure, balloon_incursion; sabotage: arson, explosive, rail_sabotage, infrastructure_sabotage, assassination_plot, proxy_recruitment, sabotage_arrest; maritime: cable_damage, pipeline_damage, shadow_fleet_incident, naval_confrontation, vessel_seizure, mine_drift, strike_at_sea; cyber_ew: gnss_jamming, gnss_spoofing, cyberattack, ddos, election_cyber; military_pressure: exercise_near_border, force_buildup, snap_readiness, probe, border_violation; nuclear: nuclear_exercise, nuclear_deployment, plant_safety_event; political_economic: election_interference, influence_operation, disinformation_campaign, energy_coercion, migration_pressure

host_statement.description: Has the affected government or agency spoken?

disruption_hours.description: E.g. hours an airport was closed

url.description: https URL you opened, saw in search results, or found in the pack. Never news.google.com

published_at.description: ISO timestamp with offset if known, a YYYY-MM-DD date if only the day is known, else null

sources.description: Non-seed: ≥ 2 from ≥ 2 categories, including the host statement when host_statement is yes
